name: @arraypress/number-parse
description: Read numbers and prices the way people type them and pages show them: locale decimal marks, thousands, Indian and apostrophe groups, signs and accounting parentheses, and currency symbols, codes and shop markers from Intl.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run duplication
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && diff -r -x '*.js' .types src && rm -rf .types

author: David Sherlock
